title: Crispi Sesame Broccoli Crowns
description: Broccoli with sesame cream sized for two and finished just before serving.
equipment: Ninja Crispi, 4-qt glass container and adapter

steps.title: Prepare the vegetables
steps.text: Cut freshly washed broccoli into even broad florets; slice thick stems thinner. Use {broc}.

steps.title: Prepare the center
steps.text: Steam for just 1 minute, then drain so the stems stay crisp-tender.

steps.title: Mix the finish
steps.text: Whisk {sesame}, {tahini}, {ricevin} in a small pan over low heat until smooth. Add a spoonful of warm water if needed.

steps.title: Roast the vegetables
steps.text: Brush with {oil}. Place in one layer on the crisper plate in the 4-qt glass container. Fit the adapter and PowerPod and select Air Fry. Cook 4–7 minutes in the Crispi until just crisp-tender.

steps.title: Dress while warm
steps.text: Spoon the sesame dressing over the crowns with the prepared mixture and serve straight away.

notes: Make ahead: prepare the topping a day ahead. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: No. The high-water vegetables soften after thawing. Freeze only if texture is secondary. Fridge reheat: warm covered to 165°F; add the topping last. Freezer reheat: thaw in the fridge before warming covered. Use unsalted plant butter or dairy-free cheese where needed. Option A uses rice vinegar; Option B replaces it with warm water. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 139 kcal, 4.4 g protein, 9.4 g total carbohydrate, 9.6 g fat, 3.7 g fiber, 53 mg sodium.
